allowances.consumer: Developers and repository quality workflows invoking pnpm check:legacy-debt
allowances.correctnessInvariant: The command must continue to reject reachable retired imports, aliases, shims, and duplicated success paths required by repository governance.
allowances.fieldScope: Root package script name for the read-only repository debt audit only
allowances.isolationRule: The command scans source files and exits with diagnostics; it is not imported by product code and cannot read, rewrite, migrate, repair, or invalidate user data.
allowances.removalCondition: Remove this allowance when AGENTS.md, the quality ADR, and all documented quality gates adopt a replacement command name with the same static audit coverage.
allowances.versionFreeAnalysis: No version-free runtime replacement is needed because this occurrence is a stable developer command label, not a contract version, data generation, compatibility reader, or migration implementation. Renaming it independently would break required governance entry points without changing product behavior.
